sampling_frame: The complete frozen 437-package Movebank Data Repository public catalog. A second independent Loxodonta africana publication was selected by taxonomy, Southern Hemisphere locale and publicly declared original GPS data volume, NOT based on its night/day seasonal displacement effect.

source.label: kruger_elephant_2007
source.study_title: Fine-scale tracking of ambient temperature and movement reveals shuttling behavior of elephants to water

primary: Use the identical independent Etosha elephant v1 observation algorithm: within animal choose at most one recorded fix at each UTC clock hour using only timestamp, then original Southern v0 sun-phase/30–120min GPS-step analysis with >=3 day and night fixes per date, <=5min daylength mismatch, >=30d date separation, >=10 matched pairs/animal-solar-year, 0.5–2 falling/rising sample count ratio, 2000 individual bootstrap. Report all qualified/null/negative results with source-level attribution.
secondary: Original adjacent-fix cadence endpoint (same as Etosha v0) reported separately to reveal sensor dependence; never pool the two endpoints into one effect.
reference: Etosha source-specific elephant hourly-v1 effect -0.15012724713090492 in 14 admitted animals (from a different study and observation years), is pre-observed background rather than a blinded holdout. No equality or directional result required for inclusion.
preeffect_sensor_inventory: Publish provider-verified original CSV column names to identify whether source reports actual onboard temperature, but do not interpret unsourced sensor columns as direct individual body temperature.
failure_policy: Original MD5/access failure or insufficient matched-day sample remains source_hold or insufficient_independent_animals, not an animal-level zero or license to retune the sampling gates.
inference_boundary: A different elephant source is still one sample, not species-wide generality. Kruger 2007 and Etosha 2008-2013 are not temporally replicated, and differences could reflect habitat, water, sex, tag, year or protocol. Raw location or tag IDs not redistributed; CC0 original metadata credited.
